title: Why do we have bones?
examples: Why are bones important for our bodies?
What do our bones help us do?
Do bones just keep us standing up?

explain.say: Your bones hold you up, so you can stand tall.
Bones keep the soft parts inside your body safe.
Your bones help you move your arms and legs.

draw.text: Bones help us move our body.

explain.say: When you run and play, your bones and muscles work together.

draw.text: Running uses your bones to move.

explain.say: Some bones keep your insides safe. Your skull keeps your brain safe.
Bones are hard, but they are alive. They grow as you grow.

items: Bones are strong but also flexible.
They work with muscles to move.
They are living parts of you.

faq.q: Why do we need bones at all?
faq.a: We need bones because they give our body its shape and support everything.
asks: What is the job of my skeleton?
Are bones just for looking strong?

faq.a: Yes, a little. Your ribs move when you breathe, and they protect your lungs.
asks: Do ribs help me take a breath?

faq.a: Your muscles pull on your bones to move you. You need both.
asks: What happens if I lose my bones?
Do I need bones to walk?

faq.q: Are bones always the same color?
faq.a: Living bones are a pale cream colour.
The strong bones of your skull protect your soft brain inside your head.
asks: Does my head have bones for protection?

facts: Bones give the body its shape and structure.
The rib cage protects the heart and lungs.
Bones work with muscles to allow movement.
The skeleton is made up of many different bones.

quiz.say: What is one job of your bones?
quiz.why: Bones are a strong frame. They hold your body up.

quiz.say: Which bones keep your brain safe?
quiz.why: Your skull is a hard case around your brain.

wrong.1: Your toe bones help you walk and balance.
wrong.2: Your ribs keep your heart and lungs safe.

quiz.say: Which of these uses your bones to move?
quiz.why: Kicking uses the bones and muscles in your leg.

wrong.0: Listening uses your ears, and your body can stay still.
wrong.1: Thinking uses your brain, and your body can stay still.
